messages:
maria: Heads up — regen landed on main last night and we're getting 401s from both TS and Python clients. Support queue is filling up.

sam: Can you paste repro?

maria: Quick repro:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/completions \
  -d '{"model":"r-instruct","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response: `401 {"error":"missing header: x-api-version"}`. Then client retries 5x -> lots of small billed requests.

izzy: Which client versions?

maria: TS 2.4.0-beta, Python 1.5.1. Regen seems to have flipped an optional header into a required mapping during generation.

chris: CI shows the regen job changed header ordering/required flags. eng-ci-bot reported `regen-client-spec -> header required=true` in job 10234.

eng-ci-bot: Job 10234: regen-spec -> failures in `client-header-ordering` test. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/10234 (logs attached)

support_bot: Flagged P1: 31 tickets; 4 dedicated customers impacted; billing spike observed in last 2 hours.

sam: Short-term workaround: inject `X-Api-Version` default in SDK transport if missing. I'll open quick PR for TS & Python with header fallback and a patch release.

izzy: I have a draft PR: `fix(regen): preserve optional header mapping and add runtime fallback` with snippet:```ts
// transport.ts
if (!opts.headers['x-api-version']) {
  opts.headers['x-api-version'] = '2026-03-01';
}
```
Will run tests then publish patch.

maria: Thx. I bisected to commit `cf3a9b6` in regen-tooling; it changed how `header.required` is inferred from the OpenAPI extension. We should revert that inference and add an explicit spec lint to catch this.

chris: Plan:
- roll quick SDK patches for TS & Python today (patch release)
- revert regen inference in tooling and add test in regen CI
- add postmortem and refund plan for billing spike

support_bot: Billing & CX notified, refunds queued for affected customers.

maria: I'll coordinate postmortem + changelog note so customers know what changed and why.

sam: Also adding a CI assertion: regen job must assert headers marked optional in OpenAPI remain optional in generated clients.

izzy: will add test in regen pipeline.

maria: Good work. Keep me posted, I will update the active support thread. :thumbsup:
